title: Coherent quotient presentations and the canonical derived reduction comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ with $\ell$ invertible in every residue field. Let $S$ be a coefficient derived-system calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. There exist an ordinary quotient tensor/limit model $M$ and a compatible derived model $D$ [def-trf-completion-unit-models] with the following property. For every flat-term K-flat complex $P$ [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex] and every simultaneous quotient presentation $(C,e,\kappa)$ of $P$ whose comparison $e$ is whole-system adjunction-coherent [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], there is a strict complex isomorphism $a:M(P)\xrightarrow{\sim}C$ such that $D.\mathrm{reductionComparison}_P\,;\,Q(a)=e$ in the derived system category and $\operatorname{ev}_n(a)\,;\,\kappa_n=M.\mathrm{evaluation}_{n,P}$ for every $n\geq0$ (index $n$ denotes exponent $n+1$). The equality is asserted before applying total derived limit.

proof.text: Choose the existing canonical models for a calculus S0. Transport their reduction comparison to the supplied S using Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq. Transport the universal left-derived property and invertibility on good complexes along this natural isomorphism. The left-adjoint unit identity preserves the whole-Hom normalization. Apply the existing finiteComparison_of_unit theorem to recover the prescribed finite evaluations for S, keeping the same ordinary model and normalized right-derived limit data.

For each whole-system coherent presentation, apply the proved fixed-model comparison to the transported models M and D. It reconstructs the strict quotient isomorphism by ordinary adjunction and proves the whole-derived-system comparison by normalized double transposition. Its finite comparison identities are exactly the required ones. The extra good-complex and reduction-presentation hypotheses remain unchanged in the item statement.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentQuotientReductionComparison (W : Scheme.{t})
    (_hlW : ∀ x : W, IsUnit (l : W.residueField x))
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W) :
    ∃ (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
      (D : CompletionUnit.DerivedModel l E W S M),
    ∀ (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory)
      (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
      (e : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
      (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
          (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E W n).obj P.obj),
      CoefficientReductionPresentation l E W S.toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction
        P.obj P.property.1 C e κ →
      IsIntegralComparisonPresentationCoherent l E W S P.obj C e κ →
      ∃ a : (M.quotient l E W).obj P.obj ≅ C,
        D.reductionComparison.app P.obj ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map a.hom = e.hom ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
            κ n = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).app P.obj
